name: Nithin Babu
description: Meet Nithin Babu- Who Went from scoring a mere 33% in our Admission Test to securing AIR 216 in JEE Advanced with the help of FIITJEE. “To be an IITian is one dream I always wanted to fulfil, but being an average performer, I was never encouraged until I approached FIITJEE. Convinced with proven results of FIITJEE for decades, I decided to appear for its Admission Test on 6th April 2014, in which I scored only 33% with no scholarship. I then joined the FIITJEE Four Year Classroom Program, wherein I witnessed many other Students like me already gaining benefits from the guidance of its expert faculty. The teachers worked 360 degrees to plug in my academic loopholes. FIITJEE’s support and my determination together have made me a proud IITian in Madras, with an All India Rank 216 in JEE Advanced 2018.

name: Kartikay Goel
description: Meet Kartikay Goel, a Student with 30% in the admission test but AIR 518 in JEE Advanced. “I thank the day when I decided to join FIITJEE. Even after being an average academic performer, I planned to appear for the FIITJEE Admission Test on 27th April 2014 but scored only 30% with no scholarship. I joined its Four-Year Classroom Program. Since I joined it in Class IX only, I could take maximum benefits from the provided study materials and systematic test schedules. Joining early made my foundation concrete when I reached Class X, ultimately boosting my secondary Class performance. Only by following FIITJEE, my dream of becoming an IITian was accomplished, and I’m now studying at IIT Guwahati after clearing JEE Advanced with an All India Rank 518. Hearty thanks to FIITJEE.”

name: Ira Pachori
description: Meet Ira Pachori, a doctor who benefitted from FIITJEE’s coaching during her Class IX and X. “I am a doctor, and I did my MBBS from AIIMS, New Delhi. I studied at FIITJEE in Class IX and X, which gave me an advantage of enhanced analytical and improved decision-making skills. This gave me enough confidence to pursue the Medical stream later in Class XI and XII. The principles learnt at FIITJEE are benefiting me even now. Indeed, joining FIITJEE till Class X was the apt decision for me.”

name: Barkha Singh
description: Meet Barkha Singh, a lawyer grateful to FIITJEE for her analytical skills and her ability to clear CLAT. “To achieve my aim of building a career in law, I took Humanities in Class XI and XII. To develop my analytical and reasoning skills and logical thinking, I chose to study at FIITJEE from Class VIII to X. Only because FIITJEE taught me to solve analytical reasoning questions integral to competitive exams, I could clear CLAT. Today, I am enrolled in BA LLB at Nalsar, Hyderabad.”

name: Srishti Chopra
description: Meet Srishti Chopra, an economics honours Student with exceptional critical-thinking skills. “It was my pre-set goal to choose Commerce after Class X and make a career in Economics. And to strengthen my mathematics and critical-thinking skills, I joined FIITJEE from Class VII to X. Those 4 years of beneficial learning made me academically sound to pursue Economics Honours from Indraprastha University, New Delhi.”

name: Abhishek Sharma
description: Meet Abhishek Sharma, a management professional who appreciates FIITJEE’s contribution to his success. “I wanted to become a management professional and, thus, took Arts in Class XI and XII to cement my academic foundation. I studied at FIITJEE in Class IX and X. FIITJEE developed my IQ and strategic thinking skills and infused me with enough confidence to pursue my BBE. Today, I am doing an MBA in Marketing, and the learnings of FIITJEE still remain the biggest support in my life and career.”

name: Keerthi Vasan
description: Meet Keerthi Vasan, an IAS officer who was able to crack UPSC exams with FIITJEE’s learning formula. “I am an IAS officer and always wanted to be one. Since I wanted to opt for the Science stream in Class XI and XII, I joined FIITJEE right in Class IX and continued studying till Class XII. This enhanced my IQ and developed rational thinking and problem-solving tactics prerequisites to crack the UPSC exam. The learning at FIITJEE helps me to date in real-life applications.”
